Messages.Author: Judith Cookson Grunberger
Messages.Body:
I seem to remember there being a ruling on this, but I can't remember
it...

When you bring the Parthenon into play, can you immediately tap it to gain
an extra master phase action? Card text seems to indicate that you can.

--Judy

Messages.Author: LSJ (VtES Rep)
Messages.Body:
The Parthenon can be tapped to gain an additional
MPA on the same turn it is brought into play.

As far as I know, yes.

No errata is on it. Whether I agree with that is a different matter,
but you *can* tap the Parthenon as soon as it comes into play.
